note: SYNTHETIC. Written by hand for WO-043 (2026-10-20) to test whether classifyMail generalises to wordings it was not tuned on. Modelled on how ATSs (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, iCIMS, SmartRecruiters, Taleo, SuccessFactors, Jobvite, BambooHR, Rippling), assessment vendors (HireVue, Codility, HackerRank, CodeSignal, Karat, Pymetrics, SHL, Criteria, TestGorilla, Vervoe, Modern Hire) and human recruiters write: terse and long, casual and corporate, non-native English, misleading subjects, soft rejections, and hard 'other' look-alikes (card, loan, rental, admissions, insurance and account applications, scams, promos, job-alert digests, calendar notices, surveys, newsletters, practice sites). No real person's mail is in it. Company names are used only so sender and subject shapes are realistic; none of these messages was sent by those companies. Every label was written before any WO-043 rule change and committed on its own. Splits: 'dev4' (tuned on) and 'dev4check' (a fixed-seed quarter: FNV-1a of id + 'wo-043-seed-20261020', mod 4 == 0; never tuned on, scored once at the end). Fields as in mail-labels.json.
